subject: Productize current-host resource admission without creating a second admission authority
decision: Materialize a host bootstrap/admission orchestrator with two HRB-authorized execution paths: generic short-lived scope-bound admission authorization for CPU-only/non-accelerator workloads, and the existing accelerator lease path only when an accelerator resource class is requested.
rationale: Manual inventory/conformance/raw-artifact choreography is unsuitable as normal product UX.
The Host Resource Broker remains the sole resource admission, placement, reservation and lease authority.
CPU-only operation is a mandatory hardware baseline and must not depend on accelerator discovery or a fake accelerator lease.
The orchestrator may prepare typed requests and invoke privileged HRB bridges but cannot mint, sign, cryptographically validate or override either authorization class.
Accelerator discovery remains conditional and request-hint-only until HRB issues a valid accelerator lease.
Normal application/runtime execution stays non-root after one-time bridge installation.
